title: Nest each package's tests/ directory inside its own package dir for import-linter test coverage
description: Currently squall/tests, cicada/tests, jackal/tests are siblings of their respective source package dirs, not nested inside them, so they cannot appear in one shared import-linter independence contract as squall.tests.*, cicada.tests.*, jackal.tests.* (dotted paths require true nesting, not sibling directories). Decided (2026-07-05, monorepo migration design) to ship the migration with a source-only shared contract (cics, squall, jackal) and defer test-directory coverage. This issue tracks the follow-up: physically move each package's tests/ directory one level deeper inside its own package dir (e.g. squall/tests -> squall/squall/tests), then extend the shared .importlinter contract to include the resulting *.tests modules.
